company.name: AlgoX2
company.shortDescription: AlgoX2 is a data-streaming platform that delivers ultra-low latency, high throughput, and minimal footprint for an AI-native world.
company.description:
AlgoX2, backed by Bessemer Venture Partners, is a clean-sheet data-streaming platform designed by the team behind the New York Stock Exchange’s trading technology.
It is Kafka API compatible with native support for Redis, NATS, and MQTT. AlgoX2 unifies stream processing, connectors, and lakehouse gateways in a single fault-tolerant cluster, delivering up to 10X higher throughput and up to 90% lower TCO than legacy stacks, with ultra-low latency.
